automotive-ev-battery.title: Waymo receives green light for expansion across California
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Waymo has secured regulatory approval from the California Public Utilities Commission for its largest robotaxi service expansion to date, extending operations across 18 districts from Sonoma to San Diego. This represents a significant milestone in autonomous vehicle deployment and commercial viability in the United States.

automotive-ev-battery.title: UK launches consultation on EV sales mandate
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The UK government has initiated a review of its Zero Emission Vehicle mandate with potential relaxation of EV sales targets from 2027 to 2035. Industry stakeholders have a two-month window to submit formal responses on the proposed policy changes.

automotive-ev-battery.title: BMW preps Leipzig plant for Neue Klasse production
automotive-ev-battery.summary: BMW has completed significant upgrades at its Leipzig manufacturing facility during a production halt, installing 160 new robots and replacing 240 lift tables in preparation for Neue Klasse model production. The facility modernization represents a major investment in next-generation EV manufacturing capacity.

automotive-ev-battery.title: 2027 Hyundai IONIQ 5 prices revealed, starting at $35,000
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The 2027 Hyundai IONIQ 5 will launch with a starting price of $35,000, positioning it as one of the most competitively priced electric vehicles available in the US market. This pricing strategy reinforces Hyundai's commitment to affordability in the mainstream EV segment.

automotive-ev-battery.title: BYD's electric supercar beats Porsche on both speed and price
automotive-ev-battery.summary: BYD's Denza Z electric supercar features a tri-motor powertrain delivering over 1,500 horsepower, achieving 0-62 mph acceleration in under 2 seconds while undercutting the price of a Porsche 911 Turbo S. The vehicle demonstrates the competitive performance capabilities emerging from Chinese EV manufacturers.

automotive-ev-battery.title: DRIVN to deploy 100 electric trucks with AVG Logistics in India
automotive-ev-battery.summary: EV leasing platform DRIVN has partnered with logistics company AVG Logistics to deploy 100 electric trucks across India, with the initial 30 units entering service in August. The agreement represents significant expansion of commercial electric vehicle adoption in the Indian logistics sector.

automotive-ev-battery.title: ÖBB Postbus tests autonomous e-bus from Otokar
automotive-ev-battery.summary: ÖBB Postbus and Turkish manufacturer Otokar are conducting pilot tests of a fully autonomous electric bus capable of SAE Level 4 driving, with initial trials at the European Forum Alpbach before deployment on the Campus Wolfurt to local S-Bahn connection. This represents significant progress in autonomous public transit implementation.

automotive-ev-battery.title: USA: Tesla launches V2L adapter for the Model Y Premium
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Tesla has introduced a Vehicle-to-Load adapter available in the United States for approximately $80, enabling energy discharge capability for Model Y Premium vehicles. The accessory currently excludes basic Model Y variants, representing an expansion of vehicle-to-load functionality in Tesla's product ecosystem.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Ebusco significantly reduces its losses
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Electric bus manufacturer Ebusco has nearly halved its operating losses in the first half of 2026 and achieved positive gross margin for the first time since 2022, though delivery volumes remain constrained at 16 units compared to 47 in the prior year. The improved profitability indicates progress toward financial sustainability despite continued challenges in sales momentum.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Chevrolet ends China sales after 21 years as focus shifts to exports
automotive-ev-battery.summary: General Motors is concluding Chevrolet's retail operations in China after nearly two decades, while maintaining local production facilities for export markets. The strategic shift reflects changing market dynamics and GM's refocused approach to Chinese operations.

science-space.title: Hubble Solves Merger Mystery From Milky Way's Early Years
science-space.summary: New data from the Hubble Space Telescope provides definitive evidence of a dwarf galaxy merging with the young Milky Way during the earliest phases of its evolution. This discovery offers crucial insights into the formation and early development of our galaxy.

science-space.title: How an ancient collision with another galaxy transformed the Milky Way
science-space.summary: Researchers have uncovered evidence of a previously unknown history of galaxy mergers that fundamentally shaped the Milky Way's structure and composition. These discoveries are revealing how our galaxy was transformed by interactions with other galaxies early in cosmic history.

science-space.title: Scientists find 3 supermassive black holes on the verge of collision inside a distant galaxy
science-space.summary: Astronomers have detected a rare system containing three supermassive black holes approaching collision in a distant galaxy that existed less than 1.3 billion years after the Big Bang. This extraordinary discovery provides unprecedented insights into black hole mergers and galaxy evolution in the early universe.

science-space.title: A 'river' of cosmic gas 1 trillion miles long sent planets in the Orion constellation into tilted orbits
science-space.summary: Astronomers have identified a massive stream of cosmic gas spanning over one trillion miles that is interacting with a young planet-forming system in Orion, causing its planets to adopt tilted orbital configurations. This discovery reveals new mechanisms by which planetary systems can be dynamically altered during their formation.

science-space.title: Scientists find dead star that predicts our sun's future: 'Broken apart and returned to the galaxy'
science-space.summary: Researchers have identified a white dwarf surrounded by the remnants of destroyed planetary bodies, offering a sobering glimpse of the fate awaiting our own solar system. This discovery demonstrates how planetary systems ultimately disperse when their parent stars reach the end of their lives.

science-space.title: Colorful Collage of Tarantula Nebula
science-space.summary: A composite image combining data from NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory, James Webb Space Telescope, and Hubble Space Telescope reveals unprecedented detail of the Tarantula Nebula in the Large Magellanic Cloud. The multi-wavelength observation showcases the power of coordinated space-based astronomy to unveil the complexities of stellar formation regions.

science-space.title: NASA Challenge Tests Wheel Designs for Moon Base Mobility
science-space.summary: NASA's Rock and Roll Challenge has advanced five teams from 128 submissions across 49 countries to the final phase of designing next-generation lunar rover wheels. The competition aims to enhance surface mobility capabilities essential for supporting crewed operations on the planned Moon Base.

science-space.title: China bounces back from Long March rocket explosion with back-to-back launches
science-space.summary: China's space program has successfully returned to operations following an August 10 Long March 7A rocket failure, launching both a Long March 12 and Long March 2C rocket on August 16. The rapid recovery demonstrates the resilience of China's launch capabilities and commitment to its space program objectives.

science-space.title: Curiosity Blog, Sols 4975-4981: Happy 14th Landing Anniversary
science-space.summary: The NASA Curiosity rover team celebrated the mission's 14th anniversary on Mars, reflecting on the remarkable longevity and scientific achievements of the rover since its 2012 landing. The milestone underscores the enduring success of the mission in advancing our understanding of Martian geology and potential past habitability.

science-space.title: NASA Mission Studies Air Pollution Over Ethiopia
science-space.summary: A NASA-funded air pollution monitoring network has captured detailed long-term measurements of black carbon concentrations in Addis Ababa, revealing how soot from fires, vehicles, and combustion sources varies by time of day and season. The findings contribute important data on atmospheric pollution dynamics in East Africa.

finance-markets.title: Private credit under strain as troubled loans swell
finance-markets.summary: Financial Times analysis reveals stress signals in the private credit market have returned to levels last observed in 2017, indicating growing deterioration in loan quality. The finding raises concerns about the stability of a sector that has expanded significantly in recent years as investors sought alternatives to traditional banking.

finance-markets.title: US tech stock correction likely, warn ECB economists
finance-markets.summary: European Central Bank economists caution that a boom-bust pattern in US technology stocks could pose a question of financial stability for the eurozone. The warning highlights concerns about valuation excesses in the tech sector and potential spillover effects on European financial markets.

finance-markets.title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.31%, the highest in 19 years
finance-markets.summary: The 30-year Treasury yield has climbed to 5.31%, reaching its highest level in nearly two decades as traders await the latest Federal Reserve policy minutes. The surge in long-dated yields reflects shifting expectations regarding future interest rate policy and inflation dynamics.

finance-markets.title: Oil Rises on Middle East Concerns, Bonds Decline: Markets Wrap
finance-markets.summary: Oil prices advanced amid dimming prospects for peace in the Middle East, reviving concerns about potential supply disruptions from prolonged geopolitical tensions. The move underscores how regional instability continues to influence global energy markets and investor sentiment across asset classes.

finance-markets.title: Guggenheim Rushes to Clarify 77% Earnings Drop After Loan Slides
finance-markets.summary: Guggenheim Investments moved to explain a steep 77% decline in second-quarter earnings following deterioration in its loan portfolio, with the disclosure prompting a sharp decline in the financing entity's loan price. The clarification effort reflects investor concerns about credit quality in investment firms' balance sheets.

finance-markets.title: Petrobras Mulls Improving Braskem Credit Terms Amid Debt Talks
finance-markets.summary: Brazil's Petrobras is considering granting improved payment terms to its subsidiary Braskem to help the petrochemical producer navigate a debt crisis ahead of an August 24 deadline that could trigger bankruptcy protection. The negotiations underscore broader stress in Brazil's industrial sector and debt markets.

finance-markets.title: Gold Holds Two-Day Gain on Reduced Rate-Hike Expectations
finance-markets.summary: Gold prices maintained recent gains as diminished expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate increases weakened the US dollar, making bullion more affordable for international investors. The move reflects shifting monetary policy expectations and their influence on precious metals demand.

finance-markets.title: Hedge Fund Tax Break Grips Hong Kong as Banks Fear Exodus
finance-markets.summary: Hong Kong's new tax incentives for hedge funds have triggered frenzied activity among investment banks concerned about losing proprietary traders and talent to the newly attractive jurisdiction. The competitive pressure highlights the significant impact of tax policy on financial center competitiveness and capital flows.

finance-markets.title: Hydro-Quebec Inks $36 Billion Energy Deal With Newfoundland
finance-markets.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador secured improved terms in a new 50-year electricity supply agreement with Hydro-Quebec valued at $36 billion, likely resolving a long-standing dispute over energy pricing. The deal represents a significant capital commitment and reflects growing demand for reliable clean energy supply.

finance-markets.title: Mark Carney in last-ditch effort to avoid Trump's latest tariffs
finance-markets.summary: Canada's economic envoy Mark Carney is scheduled to call US President Trump before a Wednesday deadline in an attempt to avert additional tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian trade. The negotiations underscore the high stakes of US trade policy for neighboring economies dependent on cross-border commerce.

tech-ai.title: Anthropic's annualized revenue surges to $65B
tech-ai.summary: Anthropic, a leading AI model maker, has increased its annualized revenue to $65 billion, adding $18 billion in just two months. This dramatic growth underscores the rapidly expanding commercial demand for advanced AI capabilities in the enterprise market.

tech-ai.title: Higgsfield raises $400M Series B, quadrupling its valuation in 8 months to $5.4B
tech-ai.summary: Higgsfield, an AI image and video generation platform founded by former Snap executive Alex Mashrabov, has raised $400 million in Series B funding, valuing the company at $5.4 billion. The funding round demonstrates strong investor confidence in generative AI tools for creative content production.

tech-ai.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google's Chrome team
tech-ai.summary: Relay, an AI automation startup, has shut down operations with its team joining Google's Chrome division to work on AI-powered productivity features within the browser. The acquisition signals Google's strategic focus on integrating AI capabilities directly into its core products.

tech-ai.title: 'Unprecedented' number of Apple users received recent spyware alert, say investigators
tech-ai.summary: Cybersecurity researchers report an unusually high number of Apple users recently received spyware threat notifications, raising concerns about a potential widespread security incident. The notification surge suggests either a significant new threat campaign or a major vulnerability affecting Apple's ecosystem.

tech-ai.title: Uber partners with Zipline on Eats drone deliveries
tech-ai.summary: Uber has partnered with drone delivery company Zipline and made a strategic investment to launch airborne food deliveries this year, with plans to achieve one million daily drone deliveries by 2029. The collaboration reflects accelerating adoption of autonomous delivery technology as regulatory barriers continue to ease.

tech-ai.title: Apple ordered to stop scaring iPhone and iPad users away from third-party apps
tech-ai.summary: Germany's Federal Cartel Office has mandated that Apple redesign its App Tracking Transparency prompts, which investigators found were biased toward Apple's own apps and discouraged users from granting tracking permissions to competitors. The ruling addresses concerns that Apple's consent interface violated fair competition rules under the EU's Digital Markets Act.

tech-ai.title: Reddit begins testing a new audio and video experience, similar to popular TikTok videos
tech-ai.summary: Reddit is testing audio and video renditions of popular text-based posts, allowing users to consume Reddit content through alternative formats similar to TikTok's short-form video model. The initiative aims to expand Reddit's appeal and engagement with users who prefer visual and auditory content consumption.

tech-ai.title: YouTube is changing how it counts views to give the numbers a boost
tech-ai.summary: YouTube will begin counting a view immediately when a video starts playing, effective August 24th, aligning with metrics used by Instagram, TikTok, and its own Shorts platform. The change is expected to increase reported view counts for creators but raises questions about the comparability of engagement metrics across platforms.

tech-ai.title: Feedly attributes weeklong slowdown to bug, not its AI pivot
tech-ai.summary: Feedly has attributed a week-long service outage that rendered its web app nearly unusable to a software bug rather than issues stemming from its AI integration efforts. The incident has sparked user frustration and raised questions about the platform's infrastructure stability and customer support responsiveness.

tech-ai.title: Sonos finally added Live Activities controls for your iPhone lockscreen
tech-ai.summary: Sonos has released a mobile app update that introduces iOS Live Activities support, enabling iPhone users to access playback controls directly from their lockscreen. The long-requested feature improves user convenience for quick music and podcast control without opening the full Sonos application.

world-news.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
world-news.summary: President Trump has threatened military action against Oman, a key US ally, amid escalating tensions over Iran negotiations and control of the Strait of Hormuz. The threat comes as a 60-day peace negotiation window expires, signaling potential widening of regional conflict.

world-news.title: Iran war live: Trump rejects MoU extension as US claims control of Hormuz
world-news.summary: The US president has rejected extending the Memorandum of Understanding with Iran and declared American control over the Strait of Hormuz, demanding Iranian surrender. The escalation represents a major shift in US-Iran policy with global implications for energy markets and regional stability.

world-news.title: Civilians paying price as Israeli military raises stakes in Lebanon: UNIFIL
world-news.summary: UN peacekeeping forces have documented a dramatic escalation in military activity along the Israeli-Lebanese border, with an average of 137 projectiles fired daily over the past two weeks. The surge in violence is causing significant civilian casualties and displacement in the region.

world-news.title: 'We will not allow Gaza to be rebuilt' until Hamas disarms, Kushner says
world-news.summary: Donald Trump's Middle East envoy Jared Kushner has stated that Gaza reconstruction will be blocked until Hamas disarms, while asserting the US will not restrict Israel's military operations. The declaration reflects the hardline stance within the Trump administration toward the Gaza conflict and Palestinian reconstruction efforts.

world-news.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
world-news.summary: The Trump administration has announced plans to scale back joint military exercises with South Korea, citing his relationship with North Korea's leader as justification. The move raises concerns about regional security commitments in East Asia during heightened international tensions.

world-news.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
world-news.summary: Russian and Ukrainian forces have exchanged significant military strikes, with Moscow reporting nine deaths and Kyiv reporting four deaths over 24 hours. The ongoing escalation reflects continued intensity in the conflict with no signs of de-escalation.

world-news.title: Russia's prominent anti-war politician jailed for 11 years
world-news.summary: Russian opposition politician Lev Schlosberg has been sentenced to 11 years in prison on charges of 'discrediting' the military, a conviction widely viewed as politically motivated. The case underscores Russia's suppression of domestic dissent and anti-war activism.

world-news.title: Kushner hails 'very good' meeting with Netanyahu after Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
world-news.summary: Trump's Middle East envoy Jared Kushner has held discussions with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu regarding a US-backed Gaza peace proposal. The diplomatic engagement represents ongoing efforts to reshape the post-conflict landscape in Gaza, though specifics of the plan remain contested.

world-news.title: French PM heckled over wildfire response as blazes continue across Europe
world-news.summary: France's Prime Minister faces criticism over the government's response to devastating wildfires sweeping across European regions, with €12 million in aid announced for affected areas. The fires highlight the escalating climate-related disaster risks facing the continent.

world-news.title: As rubble clears, Colombia begins focusing on recovery after the earthquake
world-news.summary: Colombia is transitioning from emergency rescue operations to long-term recovery efforts following a devastating earthquake that killed dozens and displaced thousands. The reconstruction phase presents significant humanitarian and economic challenges for the nation.

health-biotech.title: AstraZeneca touts separate late-stage lung cancer wins with Tagrisso, Enhertu
health-biotech.summary: AstraZeneca reported positive Phase 3 trial results for two distinct lung cancer treatments: a combination of Tagrisso and Orpathys, and its blockbuster antibody-drug conjugate Enhertu. These successes represent significant clinical victories for the company's oncology pipeline.

health-biotech.title: AstraZeneca cans late-stage volrustomig trial after lung cancer setback
health-biotech.summary: AstraZeneca has discontinued a Phase 3 study of volrustomig, marking another setback in the company's oncology development programs. The decision reflects ongoing challenges in the drugmaker's pipeline advancement.

health-biotech.title: Argenx declares Phase 3 win for Vyvgart Hytrulo in autoimmune myositis
health-biotech.summary: Argenx announced that Vyvgart Hytrulo met its primary endpoint in a Phase 3 trial for rare autoimmune myositis disorders, though the subcutaneous treatment missed efficacy targets in a key patient subgroup. The positive data advances the company's rare disease portfolio.

health-biotech.title: The IRS is probing UnitedHealth, and a private equity slowdown
health-biotech.summary: UnitedHealth Group faces an Internal Revenue Service investigation regarding potential tax avoidance practices, which could result in significant tax liabilities. The probe occurs amid broader scrutiny of private equity involvement in healthcare consolidation.

health-biotech.title: EyePoint's bid to compete with Eylea falls flat
health-biotech.summary: EyePoint's experimental wet age-related macular degeneration treatment failed to demonstrate superiority over Eylea in a Phase 3 trial, resulting in a 70% stock price decline. The setback represents a significant commercial disappointment for the company's flagship program.

health-biotech.title: Sanofi to lay off 229 workers in Mass., a year after $9.1B Blueprint Medicines acquisition
health-biotech.summary: Sanofi announced layoffs of over 200 employees in Massachusetts, one year following its $9.1 billion acquisition of Blueprint Medicines. The restructuring reflects post-merger integration activities at one of the state's major pharmaceutical employers.

health-biotech.title: Lilly to pay up to $370M for OmniAb collab; Slate, Fulcrum forge reverse merger
health-biotech.summary: Eli Lilly entered into a licensing and collaboration agreement with OmniAb for ion channel drug discovery, with potential payments reaching $370 million. The partnership demonstrates Lilly's continued investment in innovative drug discovery technologies.

health-biotech.title: AI will be better than doctors at some medical tasks, healthcare and VC experts predict
health-biotech.summary: Healthcare leaders and venture capital investors predict that artificial intelligence will surpass physicians in performance on certain basic clinical tasks by 2030, though current clinical AI tools are designed for physician-supervised use. The forecast underscores the transformative potential of AI in healthcare delivery.

health-biotech.title: Summit, Akeso's ivonescimab shows smaller benefit with longer follow-up in China
health-biotech.summary: Summit Therapeutics and Akeso's ivonescimab received approval in China for first-line lung cancer treatment, though extended follow-up data revealed a reduced clinical benefit compared to initial analysis. The updated dataset may impact the drug's commercial trajectory in key markets.

health-biotech.title: Epic confronts unprecedented challenges as it prepares to address customers and unveil road map
health-biotech.summary: Epic Systems, whose electronic health record software dominates American hospitals, faces unprecedented operational and regulatory challenges ahead of its annual User Group Meeting. The company must address succession planning, artificial intelligence strategy, and antitrust concerns.

crypto-web3.title: U.S. Treasury Department proposes GENIUS Act stablecoin rule
crypto-web3.summary: The Treasury Department has proposed regulations to implement the GENIUS Act stablecoin law passed by Congress last year, establishing core definitions and jurisdictional frameworks for stablecoin issuance. The proposal seeks to clarify regulatory requirements for entities issuing payment stablecoins in the United States.

crypto-web3.title: How a bug in Coldcard's code went unnoticed for years, leading to $100 million in hacked funds
crypto-web3.summary: A critical vulnerability in Coldcard's code remained undiscovered for years, ultimately resulting in approximately $100 million in stolen funds and exposing the cryptocurrency community's failure to properly verify security-critical code. The incident highlights the disconnect between the industry's "don't trust, verify" ethos and actual security practices.

crypto-web3.title: Harmony plans pre-attack rollback after exploiter forged 3 trillion ONE tokens
crypto-web3.summary: The Harmony blockchain has decided to execute a pre-attack rollback following an exploit in which attackers forged 3 trillion ONE tokens, choosing this option over alternatives such as token burns or wallet blacklisting. The protocol determined that rolling back the chain state was the fairest and most secure approach to address the incident.

crypto-web3.title: BitMart founder dismisses calls for audit as users report blocked funds, unpaid employees
crypto-web3.summary: BitMart founder Sheldon Lee has rejected demands for an independent audit while users report blocked access to funds and the exchange faces allegations of unpaid employees. The founder attributed audit-related claims to a compromised Chinese-language social media account, but stakeholders continue pressing for disclosure of wallets, assets, and liabilities.

crypto-web3.title: Compound bets $52 million, new leadership team in switch to institutional focus
crypto-web3.summary: Compound, the decentralized finance protocol that pioneered lending mechanisms, is implementing a strategic pivot toward institutional clients with a $52 million investment and new leadership following significant asset declines from its five-year peak. The move reflects changing market dynamics as retail trader interest has waned and the protocol seeks to rebuild relevance.

crypto-web3.title: Ethereum's next big upgrade has 66 proposals, including a major privacy fix
crypto-web3.summary: Ethereum developers are narrowing down 66 proposals for the upcoming Hegotá upgrade, which will include significant improvements to transaction approval mechanisms and privacy tooling for wallet developers. The upgrade aims to enhance developer capabilities for privacy applications within the Ethereum protocol itself.

crypto-web3.title: Bitcoin miner HIVE inks five-year $350 million AI cloud contract, adds $70 million in annualized revenue
crypto-web3.summary: HIVE Blockchain's GPU cloud subsidiary BUZZ HPC has signed a five-year, $350 million contract for AI cloud services, adding $70 million in annual recurring revenue and representing the miner's second major NVIDIA cluster deal in two months. The agreement exemplifies the industry's broader shift toward artificial intelligence infrastructure deployment.

crypto-web3.title: Tokenized equities triple market share as Ondo, Binance and xStocks dominate
crypto-web3.summary: The tokenized equities market has experienced substantial growth, tripling its market share to 15 percent of the broader tokenized asset market with a total capitalization of approximately $2.8 billion, driven by leading platforms including Ondo, Binance, and xStocks. This expansion reflects growing institutional and retail interest in blockchain-based equity tokenization.

crypto-web3.title: Austria's FMA fines crypto broker Bitpanda $81,000 in first published MiCA penalty
crypto-web3.summary: Austria's Financial Market Authority has issued a €70,000 penalty to cryptocurrency broker Bitpanda, marking the first publicly disclosed enforcement action under the EU's Markets in Crypto-assets Regulation (MiCA). The fine addressed deficiencies in white paper disclosures and marketing materials compliance.

crypto-web3.title: Kraken parent Payward joins Anthropic's Project Glasswing for AI security push
crypto-web3.summary: Payward, the parent company of cryptocurrency exchange Kraken, has joined Anthropic's Project Glasswing initiative to enhance cybersecurity using artificial intelligence-powered vulnerability detection and remediation. The partnership will focus on identifying security flaws and sharing open-source findings with the broader industry.

startups-vc.title: Databricks Just Crossed $7B ARR Growing 80% (!): A 30-Point Acceleration, a $190B Valuation, and the Margin Bill for Agents
startups-vc.summary: Databricks announced it crossed $7 billion in annual recurring revenue with over 80% year-over-year growth and closed a $5 billion strategic funding round at a $190 billion valuation led by Coatue. The achievement represents a 30-point acceleration in growth and marks unprecedented scale in B2B software, demonstrating strong investor confidence in data and AI infrastructure.

startups-vc.title: Higgsfield raises $400M Series B, quadrupling its valuation in 8 months to $5.4B
startups-vc.summary: Higgsfield, founded by former Snap executive Alex Mashrabov, raised $400 million in Series B funding and quadrupled its valuation to $5.4 billion in just eight months. The AI image and video generation platform's rapid valuation increase reflects strong market demand for generative AI capabilities.

startups-vc.title: 40 Companies Joined The Unicorn Board In July, The Highest Count In 4 Years
startups-vc.summary: Forty companies achieved unicorn status in July 2026, the highest monthly count in four years, with financial services, robotics, AI orchestration, multimodal AI, energy, and semiconductors leading the sectors. The United States accounted for nearly half of the newly minted unicorns, signaling robust venture funding activity.

startups-vc.title: The Week's 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Data, Neolab, AI Infrastructure, Defense And AI Coding Lead
startups-vc.summary: This week's largest funding rounds were led by data, AI infrastructure, defense, and coding platforms, with Databricks raising an additional $5 billion after a comparable round eight months prior. The diverse funding landscape reflects strong investor interest across data platforms, AI neolabs, data center infrastructure, and defense technology.

startups-vc.title: Terra Industries closes $52M seed round to build defense infrastructure for the Global South
startups-vc.summary: African defense technology company Terra Industries announced it closed a $52 million seed round, incorporating an additional $18 million in new funding. The substantial seed capital underscores growing investor interest in defense infrastructure solutions for emerging markets.

startups-vc.title: Semiconductor Giants Are Busy Backing Startups This Year
startups-vc.summary: Semiconductor industry leaders are investing record amounts in artificial intelligence and robotics startups, capitalizing on massive AI spending that has driven their earnings and valuations to historic levels. The increased corporate venture activity from semiconductor majors reflects confidence in AI and robotics as high-growth segments.

startups-vc.title: Klaviyo's CEO on Building at $1.5B With Agents: "Dark Factory," Composer, and Why Every Single Employee Had to Hit L3 by June
startups-vc.summary: Klaviyo co-founder and co-CEO Andrew Bialecki discussed how the 2,300-person public company builds AI products at scale, including infrastructure innovations like "Dark Factory" and Composer. The discussion highlights organizational and technical approaches for integrating AI agents throughout enterprise software operations.

startups-vc.title: The VC Firm That Helped Build Latin America's Startup Scene Is Crossing Into Silicon Valley
startups-vc.summary: Monashees, one of Latin America's most influential venture capital firms, opened a San Francisco office to expand its presence in Silicon Valley and strengthen its positioning during the AI boom. The firm's expansion reflects a broader trend of regional venture capital firms establishing permanent U.S. presences to access emerging technologies and investment opportunities.

startups-vc.title: Sound-powered fire protection startup gets $15M to snuff out fires before they turn catastrophic
startups-vc.summary: Sonic Fire Tech raised $15 million in new funding to scale its sound-powered fire protection system designed for commercial kitchens, apartment buildings, and other settings. The funding demonstrates investor interest in novel safety technology solutions for preventing catastrophic fire damage.

startups-vc.title: AI-Native, Not AI-Sprinkle: Why AI Is A Business Change, Not A Technology Change
startups-vc.summary: According to Strattam Capital co-founder Bob Morse, companies achieve transformational productivity gains like 3x improvements by redesigning teams, roles, and workflows around AI rather than simply adding AI tools to existing processes. The perspective emphasizes that realizing AI's full potential requires CEO and board-level organizational change initiatives.

cybersecurity.title: SAP Commerce Cloud CVE-2026-58231 Targeted in Exploitation Attempts Days After Patch
cybersecurity.summary: A maximum-severity vulnerability in SAP Commerce Cloud rated 10.0 on the CVSS scoring system is experiencing active exploitation attempts shortly after a security patch was released. The flaw involves insufficient authorization checks and input validation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to abuse default authentication clients.

cybersecurity.title: Suspected China-Nexus Actor Exploits VMware vCenter Flaw, Deploys Babuk-Derived Ransomware
cybersecurity.summary: A suspected China-linked advanced persistent threat group is actively exploiting CVE-2026-59310, a critical directory-traversal vulnerability in VMware vCenter with a 9.8 CVSS score, to execute arbitrary code and deploy Babuk-derived ransomware. The exploitation demonstrates rapid weaponization of the newly patched flaw by state-sponsored threat actors.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released patches for at least 398 security vulnerabilities across Windows operating systems and supported software, including one actively exploited flaw and two others previously disclosed to the public. This substantial monthly update addresses critical weaknesses affecting millions of Windows users globally.

cybersecurity.title: Unisoc VoLTE Video Call Exploit Chain Can Give Attackers Full Android Kernel Access
cybersecurity.summary: Security researchers disclosed a two-stage exploit chain that achieves full Android kernel access through Unisoc modem vulnerabilities exploitable via VoLTE video calls, with no fix available from the chipset manufacturer. The attack requires minimal victim interaction and affects millions of Android devices using Unisoc modems.

cybersecurity.title: Forminator WordPress Flaw Can Enable Unauthenticated RCE via Malicious PHP Uploads
cybersecurity.summary: A critical vulnerability rated 9.8 on the CVSS scale has been disclosed in the Forminator Forms WordPress plugin, which has over 600,000 active installations, enabling remote code execution through malicious PHP file uploads. The flaw poses a significant threat to millions of websites utilizing this widely deployed plugin.

cybersecurity.title: Critical GitLab GraphQL Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Delete Public Projects
cybersecurity.summary: GitLab released security updates addressing a critical vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.4 in both Community and Enterprise editions that could allow unauthenticated attackers to remotely modify or delete public projects and user data. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-19478, represents a severe risk to GitLab deployments globally.

cybersecurity.title: Evooo1Bot Linux Botnet Exploits Known Flaws to Turn Edge Devices Into SOCKS5 Proxies
cybersecurity.summary: Researchers identified a previously undocumented Linux botnet family called Evooo1Bot that leverages the leaked Mirai source code while adding capabilities to transform compromised internet-facing devices into SOCKS proxies for persistent attacker infrastructure. The malware extends the original DDoS framework with exploitation modules and credential theft functionality.

cybersecurity.title: Read This Before You Buy That TV Streaming Stick
cybersecurity.summary: A groundbreaking analysis reveals that generic TV streaming boxes, already known to rent users' internet connections to strangers, also spoof themselves as mobile devices to click ads on AI-generated websites as part of a fraud scheme targeting online merchants and advertising networks. The discovery exposes a widespread supply-chain compromise affecting millions of consumers.

cybersecurity.title: How MCP Servers Can Expose Enterprise Secrets
cybersecurity.summary: Model Context Protocol servers used by organizations deploying AI agents can expose enterprise secrets through plaintext configuration files, over-permissioned access, and prompt injection attacks, often before security teams are aware the servers are operational. The emerging risk represents a critical gap in MCP server security as adoption accelerates across enterprises.

cybersecurity.title: Snowflake GitHub Actions Flaw Lets Crafted Issues Trigger Command Injection
cybersecurity.summary: Wiz researchers disclosed a GitHub Actions workflow injection vulnerability in Snowflake's public repository that could be exploited through crafted GitHub issues to execute commands with access to internal Jira credentials. The flaw in the jira_issue.yml workflow exposes sensitive credentials and enables command execution within the development pipeline.

energy-climate.title: Q&A: What does China's 15th five-year plan for coal mean for climate action?
energy-climate.summary: China has published a new five-year plan for coal that carries significant implications for global climate policy and energy transitions. The plan's details are critical for understanding China's coal trajectory and its impact on meeting climate targets.

energy-climate.title: Analysis: The two largest reservoirs in the US have hit record-low levels
energy-climate.summary: The nation's two largest reservoirs have reached record-low water levels, signaling acute water scarcity challenges linked to climate change and drought conditions. The unprecedented decline threatens water supplies, hydroelectric generation, and agricultural operations across the western United States.

energy-climate.title: Solar crosses 3 TW threshold
energy-climate.summary: Global solar capacity has surpassed 3 terawatts, with China leading expansion and emerging markets increasingly contributing to growth. The milestone underscores solar's acceleration as a primary energy source while highlighting critical needs for grid infrastructure, energy storage, and demand flexibility.

energy-climate.title: Spain extends Almaraz nuclear plant operation through 2030
energy-climate.summary: Spain has extended operating licenses for Almaraz nuclear units through June 2030, citing energy-market uncertainty and the need for firm baseload capacity during renewable expansion. The decision reverses previous nuclear shutdown plans but raises concerns among researchers about potential impacts on Spain's 2030 renewable electricity targets.

energy-climate.title: Why land-use emissions have fallen by a third this century – in six charts
energy-climate.summary: Emissions from land-use change, including deforestation and peatland loss, have declined by approximately one-third since 2000, representing significant progress in a key emissions category. The analysis demonstrates that policy interventions and changing land-management practices are yielding measurable climate benefits.

energy-climate.title: Form Energy raises $750m to expand iron-air battery production
energy-climate.summary: Form Energy has secured $750 million in Series G funding to scale production of iron-air battery systems, a technology designed for ultra-long-duration energy storage. The funding round, led by T. Rowe Price, reflects investor confidence in long-duration storage solutions critical for grid reliability during renewable transitions.

energy-climate.title: Energy storage cell shipment data for H1 2026 reveal three structural shifts
energy-climate.summary: Global energy storage cell shipments reached 467.84 gigawatt-hours in the first half of 2026, up nearly 95 percent year-on-year, demonstrating accelerating deployment of storage technology. The data from InfoLink Consulting reveals significant structural shifts in the energy storage market.

energy-climate.title: Agastya Energy plans 12 GW ingot, wafer factory in India
energy-climate.summary: Agastya Energy will invest approximately $816 million to develop a 12-gigawatt ingot and wafer manufacturing facility in Andhra Pradesh, complementing its planned 5-gigawatt cell and module capacity. The project aims to strengthen India's integrated solar supply chain and reduce dependence on imported solar components.

energy-climate.title: Chinese scientists achieve record-breaking 24.0% efficiency for large-area perovskite solar modules
energy-climate.summary: Researchers in China have achieved certified 24.0 percent efficiency on an 810-square-centimeter perovskite solar module using advanced processing techniques and lead carboxylate passivation. The breakthrough demonstrates progress toward commercializing next-generation perovskite solar technology.

energy-climate.title: South Korea signs MoU for 320MW green hydrogen complex
energy-climate.summary: South Korea has announced plans for a large-scale green hydrogen production complex at the Saemangeum site following a memorandum of understanding. The project represents a strategic expansion of South Korea's hydrogen economy and decarbonization infrastructure.

asia-pacific.title: Can Indonesia build on rising EV demand to become a production powerhouse?
asia-pacific.summary: Indonesia faces a critical opportunity to leverage its rising electric vehicle demand and abundant nickel resources under President Prabowo Subianto's administration to develop an integrated domestic EV industry. However, analysts warn that without stricter local-content regulations and stronger integration between nickel processing, battery production, and vehicle assembly, government incentives risk merely reinforcing Indonesia's role as a consumer market rather than a manufacturing hub.

asia-pacific.title: Joint Resource Exploration With China a 'Possibility' Before 2028, Philippine President Says
asia-pacific.summary: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. indicated that Manila and Beijing have made progress in energy talks and could pursue joint resource exploration before 2028, suggesting potential cooperation despite ongoing South China Sea tensions. The statement represents a significant diplomatic development in managing China-Philippines relations amid competing maritime claims.

asia-pacific.title: Trump lets 60-day deadline for Iran peace deal expire, threatens to 'bomb' Oman
asia-pacific.summary: President Donald Trump allowed a Pakistan-brokered memorandum of understanding with Iran to expire, announcing he will not seek extension as negotiations over ending regional conflict and restoring Strait of Hormuz navigation have stalled. The move escalates tensions over this critical global energy chokepoint amid accusations from both sides of violating the agreement.

asia-pacific.title: Russia summons Japan ambassador over disputed Kuril Islands row after Putin visit
asia-pacific.summary: Moscow summoned Japan's ambassador following Tokyo's condemnation of President Vladimir Putin's visit to Russia's far-eastern Kuril Islands, territories also claimed by Japan and seized by the Soviet Union in 1945. The incident represents the latest escalation in a decades-long territorial dispute that continues to strain Russian-Japanese relations.

asia-pacific.title: Are Allies' Military AI Systems Interoperable?
asia-pacific.summary: The United States, South Korea, and Japan are developing divergent AI-driven combat systems that may create interoperability challenges among allied forces during joint operations. The different technological approaches risk generating conflicting battlefield recommendations and complicating military coordination in the Indo-Pacific region.

asia-pacific.title: Claims Hegseth 'on verge of losing job' raise questions about future US-China defence ties
asia-pacific.summary: Multiple sources suggest Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth faces potential dismissal due to deadlock over Iran negotiations and negative media coverage, raising concerns about implications for U.S.-China defense relations. The potential leadership change at the Defense Department could significantly impact strategic military policy toward China and broader Indo-Pacific security architecture.

asia-pacific.title: Extreme Heat Is Hurting South Asia's Economies. Here's How Much.
asia-pacific.summary: Multiple reports document significant economic damage to South Asian economies from extreme heat, with substantial losses in wages and work hours across the region. The findings underscore climate change's tangible impact on labor productivity and economic growth in a critical Asia-Pacific region.

asia-pacific.title: Is Hong Kong's property market recovery running out of gas? UBS flags 4 risks
asia-pacific.summary: UBS warns that Hong Kong's property market recovery may moderate significantly as artificial intelligence disruptions, slower population inflows, and Greater Bay Area integration threaten to impact residential prices and rents. The forecast suggests the city's real estate sector faces headwinds from structural economic shifts and regional demographic trends.

asia-pacific.title: The Thai Government's Myanmar Gambit Could Backfire on ASEAN
asia-pacific.summary: Thailand's recent diplomatic outreach campaign toward Myanmar risks undermining ASEAN's collective and coordinated approach to the country's ongoing political crisis. The unilateral Thai initiative could weaken regional consensus and complicate the bloc's efforts to address Myanmar's instability.

asia-pacific.title: India's Collapsing Roads and Highways Dent Modi Government's Image
asia-pacific.summary: India's newly constructed expressways and highways, built at substantial cost, have failed to withstand stress from monsoon rains, damaging the Modi government's development record and raising questions about infrastructure quality. The infrastructure failures represent a significant setback to the administration's economic credentials ahead of upcoming political cycles.
